facts.business: National General Industries Ltd. is a downstream engineering-steel manufacturer that undertakes job-work activities and sells steel products, focusing on value-added engineering steel for automobile, engineering, construction, and capital goods sectors.
key_risks: Volatility in steel prices and fluctuations in raw material costs (iron ore, scrap, coal)
Competitive pressure from large and integrated steel producers
Volatility in energy and transportation costs
Pressure on margins due to lower realisations
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for payment of consultancy/professional fees of Rs. 1,50,000 per month to Mr. Manhar Modi (Non-Executive Director) and Rs. 50,000 per month to Mrs. Nandini Modi (Consultant HR) from 1st October 2026.
